name: hdri-environment-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: HDRI environment lighting (pro, Medium+). Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; selecting a curated CC0 HDRI sets state.hdriId (swapping the procedural probe for a captured environment as scene.environment), and Procedural (null) restores the default. Back-to-Simple hides the picker.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: hdriEnvironment should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: hdriEnvironment should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: default-procedural
steps.failMessage: hdriId should default to null (procedural probe)

steps.name: assert-hdri-set
steps.failMessage: selecting an HDRI should set state.hdriId

steps.name: assert-procedural
steps.failMessage: Procedural should reset hdriId to null

steps.name: assert-simple-again
steps.failMessage: hdriEnvironment should hide again in Simple
